```{r, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
# reads background-clean data csv

background <- 
  read.csv('~/Desktop/Pstat 197A/module0-class-survey-team7/data/background-clean.csv')

interest <- 
  read.csv('~/Desktop/Pstat 197A/module0-class-survey-team7/data/interest-clean.csv')
```

```{r}
# combines the two datasets into one data frame
# only keeps the courses and areas columns

combined <- interest %>% inner_join(background, by = "response_id")

combined <- combined[c("courses", "areas")]

head(combined)
```


```{r}
# list of mandatory courses

mandatory <- c("PSTAT 120", "CS 9", "PSTAT 122", "PSTAT 126", "CS 16")
```

```{r}
data <- combined %>% 
  
  # separates the string containing the list of courses into each course code
  # counts number of courses taken that were not in our list of mandatory courses
  mutate(num_non_mandatory = sum(!(strsplit(courses, 
                                split = ", ")[[1]] %in% mandatory)), 
                                .by = "courses") %>%
  
  # separates the string containing the list of areas of interest by the commas
  # counts the number of areas of interest
  # some areas of interest have ", generally" attached to the end
  # accidentally counts generally as an area since it comes after comma
  # counts the number of "generally" and subtracts from the original count
  mutate(num_areas = length(
    strsplit(areas[[1]], split = ", ")[[1]]) - 
      sum(strsplit(areas[[1]], split = ", ")[[1]] == "generally"), 
    .by = areas) %>%
  
  # only keeps the counts of non-mandatory courses and areas of interest
  # keeps the areas of interest
  select(courses, num_non_mandatory, num_areas)

head(data)
```

```{r}
# creates barplots for the number of non-mandatory courses and areas of interest

ggplot(data, aes(num_non_mandatory)) + geom_bar() + theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = "Number of Non-Mandatory Course Taken", title = "Histogram of Courses")

ggplot(data, aes(num_areas)) + geom_bar() + theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Number of Areas of Interest", title = "Histogram of Areas of Interest")
```

```{r}
# calculates the correlation coefficient 
# only uses the numerical variables
# creates a line and box plot of non-mandatory courses vs areas of interest

data_nums <- data %>% select(num_non_mandatory, num_areas)

ggpairs(data_nums, progress = F)
```


```{r}
# creates our linear regression model with only our numerical varaibles

lr <- lm(num_areas ~ num_non_mandatory, data = data)
summary(lr)
```

```{r}
plot(data$num_non_mandatory, data$num_areas)
abline(lr, col = "red")
```

```{r}
par(mfrow =c(1,2))

plot(lr)
```


```{r}
test <- data %>% 
  mutate(non_mandatory = sapply(strsplit(courses, split = ", "), function(x)
    {paste(keep(x, .p = function(x) !(x %in% mandatory)), collapse = ", ")}))
```

```{r}
all_courses <- unique(strsplit(test$non_mandatory, ", "))

all_courses
```

```{r}
all_courses[[3]]
```

```{r}
for (i in length(all_courses)) {

    contain = list(contain, all_courses[[i]][n])

}
```
